notes: Long chats keep summarising themselves when they get long. Before, one refused request (for example when credits ran out) could switch this off until the app restarted.
The /permissions list opens again when you have rules saved. The safe-mode message shows properly too.
Web search steps no longer show up twice in a chat.
When the app's chat storage is full, it saves without picture thumbnails first. If even that doesn't fit, it tells you instead of quietly losing new messages.
Permission rules for a whole connector now work, written as mcp__github or mcp__github__*.
Saved secrets are now hidden in connector and browser results too, not only in command output.
A connector that crashes or drops its connection reconnects on the next try instead of staying broken.
